generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: 12 kWh, 277.5 V lithium-ion pack (150 cells), 3 kW charger, quick charge to 80 % in about 15 min (CHAdeMO in Japan; the page names no connector). Built in about 100 units for fleets and carsharing in Japan and the US (90 for US carsharing, e.g. UC Irvine ZEV-NET); not sold to the public. MY2013 only (EPA). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scion_iQ
